page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highcpu-48 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the n4d server family. It features 48 dedicated virtual CPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core, positioning the instance within the compute-optimized hardware class.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring external network configuration for public internet routing.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local scratch space. This profile is suited for tasks such as batch processing, high-performance web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive CI/CD pipelines.
